name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is a cloud customer relationship management platform for sales, service, marketing, commerce, and analytics teams. Organizations use it to manage customer accounts, opportunities, workflows, support, reporting, and extensible business data.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Salesforce organization through Relay Console OAuth, then let agents use three bounded read-only tools for Account and Opportunity summaries. V1 excludes CRM changes, personal records, custom objects, exports, arbitrary SOQL or SOSL, broader APIs, bulk access, pagination, and raw sessions.

capabilities.label: Read accounts
capabilities.description: List bounded business Account summaries from the exact connected organization.

capabilities.label: Read opportunities
capabilities.description: List bounded Opportunity summaries or inspect one exact Opportunity.

approvalRequired.label: List accounts
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five bounded business Account summaries.

approvalRequired.label: List opportunities
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five bounded Opportunity summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read opportunity
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Opportunity by Salesforce record ID.

blocked.label: Change Salesforce records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, converting, merging, or transferring records is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read personal records
blocked.description: Contacts, Leads, Users, Cases, activities, email, files, and personal fields are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader Salesforce data
blocked.description: Custom objects, reports, dashboards, analytics, metadata, setup, and other standard objects are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary queries
blocked.description: Arbitrary SOQL, SOSL, paths, fields, filters, ordering, pagination, and raw API calls are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export or reuse sessions
blocked.description: Bulk, composite, export, frontdoor, and session-reuse access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three bounded reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact-organization and instance binding, provider-granted permissions, static queries, limits, audit, redaction, refresh rotation, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three bounded Salesforce read wrappers and attaches the encrypted organization token server-side.
Relay mounts three bounded Salesforce read wrappers and attaches the encrypted organization token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Salesforce requires a packaged External Client App for distribution to customer organizations, provider-side OAuth settings, AppExchange security review, and separate production and sandbox credentials before public Relay-owned consent can be accepted. This staging/code worker does not open provider consoles or capture credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create and package Relay Console External Client Apps for production and sandbox, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/salesforce/callback, enable PKCE, web-server and refresh client-secret requirements, refresh-token rotation, and only api plus refresh_token scopes, complete Salesforce review, store environment-specific credentials, then verify exact organization, user, and instance binding, all three reads, refresh rotation, revocation, permission denial, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Only packaged External Client Apps can be deployed to other Salesforce organizations; shared OAuth settings and packaging are controlled from the source organization.
Salesforce supports the web-server authorization-code flow with an exact redirect, client credentials, PKCE, identity and instance binding, access tokens, and optional refresh tokens.
The api scope permits Salesforce API access and refresh_token permits offline refresh; full is broader than this connector requires.
External Client Apps support exact HTTPS callbacks, PKCE, client-secret protection for web and refresh flows, selected scopes, and refresh-token policy.
Salesforce revokes a refresh or access token by form POST to the connected instance's services/oauth2/revoke endpoint.
